messages.subject: [IT] Document management system maintenance - Sunday 16 March
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear all,

The firm's document management system (NetDocuments) will be unavailable on Sunday 16 March between 06:00 and 12:00 for scheduled maintenance and a security patch. Please check in any documents you are working on before Friday close. Email will be unaffected.

IT Helpdesk
Whitfield Carter LLP
